run.executedVia: Playwright (automated); every assertion cross-checked against the ServiceNow Table API

case.title: caf_conformance_type on a request references a relationship, not a control

steps.text: Read the dictionary entry for caf_req.caf_conformance_type.
Take a live request and attempt to resolve its caf_conformance_type in the control table.
Resolve the same value in the relationship table.

observations: The field is named and labelled after the control table but points at the relationship table. A query written from the design document's data model returns zero rows and reads as missing data.
expected: The dictionary reference is x_gskn2_caf_compli_caf_relationship, despite the field name and the "CAF control name" label.
A request's caf_conformance_type value resolves in the relationship table and NOT in the control table.
actual: Control-table lookup returned 0 row(s); relationship-table lookup returned 1 row(s).
case.verdictReason: Behaviour confirmed. Raise as a documentation defect against the design document, not as a code change — renaming the field would break the task-creation flow.
